line: Bitcoin drifted higher on oversold technicals and extreme fear, but intraday strength masks persistent weekly outflows and fresh whale deposits onto exchanges.

wire_top3.line: Switzerland approved 57 countries and territories for automatic crypto tax information sharing starting 2028.
